description: Default ~5 credits (limit 10; 0.5/result). Pins from a Pinterest profile — offset cursor, pidgets window ~100. Costs ~5 credits (0.5/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response (numeric offset, e.g. 25). A null nextCursor means the end of the retrievable window (pidgets ~100).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 10, max 200). Billed per result.

url.description: Pinterest profile URL or username. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: pinterest_user_pins
title: Pinterest User Pins
